checks.finding: field_opening._player_hit rejects camp damage; positive damage reduces HP outside subject to other guards.
field_opening zero-HP branch cancels work presentation and resets; reset assigns safe_start, MAX_HP, brief invulnerability and preserves living enemy HP.
No explicit material/cash/plot/companion debit in the inspected player-hit/reset branches. This does not establish a whole-game guarantee or runtime pass.
field_settlement_loop.cancel_cooking comments retain paid hopper stock and machine work; invokes works.cancel.
field_inventory.KINDS exactly wood, stone, meat, coal, slate, metal; metal titled Metal ore.
field_progression.OFFERS has 13 named offers using wood, stone, meat; survivor wood plot separately represented.
worker_payment uses shared _pay_from on actual worker_load; requires rescued and excludes Progress.LINES.
WORKER_LIMIT = 500 / UNITS_PER_BUNDLE. Settlement validation and survivor._free_for enforce per-kind occupancy; do not call 500 a verified total mixed-load cap or throughput result.
field_logistics.PRODUCT exactly wood->planks, stone->blocks, meat->meal; stored_meal and meal_to_store are lanes, not extra inventory kinds.

serve consumes one qualifying meal and increments served; settlement EMPTY contains no distinct cash wallet; field_hud maps cash display directly from journal.served. Cash mesh alone is not a spendable wallet proof.
Reviewed OFFERS/MACHINES/PRODUCT/STORE contracts do not show coal/slate/metal sinks or downstream plank/block spending. No claim of universal absence across every branch.
Lifecycle snapshots remaining loose-drop lifetime. This is not evidence of offline erosion or confiscating already owned cargo.
